title: FILE STATUS 35 (file not found) — distinct from generic open failure; programs branch on it
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. OPEN-OR-CREATE.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT POLICY-FILE
               ASSIGN TO POLICYFL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-STAT.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  POLICY-FILE.
       01  POLICY-REC PIC X(80).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-STAT  PIC X(2).
      *> FILE STATUS '35' = file does not exist on OPEN INPUT/I-O.
      *> Legacy branches: '00' continue, '35' create-fallback,
      *> anything else hard error. Java's Files.exists() then open
      *> is correct but loses the atomic-check.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           OPEN INPUT POLICY-FILE.
           STOP RUN.
notes: File status code '35' is the COBOL standard for 'file does not exist' on input/IO open. Programs branching on it usually have a create-fallback path. The spec must capture which status codes the program checks and what each one means.
